usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Solomon Islands, Today's exchange rates (indicative)
usdRate.note: Published as USD 0.1240 per SBD 1 (about 8.06 SBD per USD); the September 2026 monthly average was 8.03 (CBSI Monthly Economic Bulletin).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of Solomon Islands, Monthly Economic Bulletin September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Headline inflation (year on year, 3-month moving average) 3.7% in August 2026, from 4.3% in July; core 3.3%. Based on SINSO national CPI.

inflation_projection.sourceName: CBSI monetary policy stance (August 2026): desired inflation range 2-5%; World Bank CPI 3.4% in 2025
inflation_projection.note: CBSI aims for inflation within 2-5% and expects about 4.4% in 2027, so we plan with 4%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Solomon Islands, Monetary Policy Stance
policy_rate.note: The Board kept the policy rate at 1.5% for the next six months at its 28 August 2026 meeting. The 28-day Bokolo Bill rate is 0.40%.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: CBSI Money and Banking Statistics, Table 1.7 Interest Rates (commercial banks)
savings_account_rate.note: Savings deposits weighted average 0.79% (range 0.60-1.39%) in March 2026.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: CBSI Money and Banking Statistics, Table 1.7 Interest Rates (commercial banks)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Time deposits 1-3 months weighted average 1.20% (3-6 months 1.05%) in March 2026.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: CBSI Money and Banking Statistics, Table 1.7 Interest Rates (commercial banks)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Time deposits 1-2 years weighted average 1.51% (6-12 months 1.53%) in March 2026.

dps_rate.note: No bank recurring-deposit product or published rate was found; CBSI publishes only savings and time-deposit rates.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Solomon Islands, Key indicators: Interest rates (July 2026)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Deposit rate 0.50% and lending rate 8.60%; the Money and Banking Statistics give an all-deposits weighted average of 0.47% for March 2026. World Bank FR.INR.DPST: 0.41% (2023).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings bond or certificate for individuals was found; government Development Bonds are sold by auction mainly to institutions.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Solomon Islands, Monthly Economic Bulletin September 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average yield on 91-day T-bills 1.13% (182-day 2.33%) in September 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year government bond yield is published; CBSI lists only 10- and 15-year Development Bonds.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: CBSI Money and Banking Statistics, Table 1.7 Interest Rates (Development Bonds 10 years)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Outstanding 10-year Development Bond rates listed at 4.67% and 5.0% (March 2026); bonds are auctioned mainly to institutions, with no secondary market.

tax_bank_interest.note: Interest paid to residents is subject to 10% withholding tax (15% for non-residents).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals exists.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme was found; CBSI's regulatory framework page describes depositor protection under the Financial Institutions Act but no insurance scheme.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No credit card rate cap or published typical card rate was found; CBSI reports personal loans at 10.1% weighted average (March 2026).

equity_return_low.sourceName: CBSI: 1-2 year time deposits 1.51% and 182-day T-bill 2.33%, less 10% resident withholding tax on interest
equity_return_low.note: No local stock exchange; low case close to the after-tax deposit rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: CBSI: 1-2 year time deposits 1.51% and 182-day T-bill 2.33%, less 10% resident withholding tax on interest
equity_return_base.note: No local stock market, so the base case is a global index in Solomon dollar terms, held to about 3.6 points over the after-tax safe rate of about 1.4%; exchange controls limit access.

equity_return_high.sourceName: CBSI: 1-2 year time deposits 1.51% and 182-day T-bill 2.33%, less 10% resident withholding tax on interest
equity_return_high.note: High case for global equities in Solomon dollar terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: CBSI: SBD 8.03 per USD (September 2026 average), 8.06 in March 2026
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a stable basket-managed currency.

gold_return_base.sourceName: CBSI: SBD 8.03 per USD (September 2026 average), 8.06 in March 2026
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4% plus slight Solomon dollar depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: CBSI: SBD 8.03 per USD (September 2026 average), 8.06 in March 2026
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: CBSI savings deposits 0.79% less 10% withholding tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits only, after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: CBSI: 1-2 year time deposits 1.51% and 182-day T-bill 2.33%, less 10% resident withholding tax on interest
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 1-2 year time deposits after tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: CBSI: 1-2 year time deposits 1.51% and 182-day T-bill 2.33%, less 10% resident withholding tax on interest
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 182-day T-bills after tax, where accessible.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates were found; the life insurance market is very small.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published figure for the cost of a major hospital stay was found; public hospital care is largely government-funded.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium rates were found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: CBSI desired inflation range 2-5%; no medical CPI published
goal_inflation_health.note: Public care is mostly free but imported medicines and overseas referrals track import prices, so we plan slightly above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: CBSI desired inflation range 2-5%; no education CPI published
goal_inflation_education.note: No education price series was found, so we plan slightly above general inflation.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.14 (2025, World Bank), 8.5 (2040) and 14.5 (2065, populationpyramid.net/solomon-islands/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Solomon Islands National Provident Fund, Benefits and withdrawals
retirement_age_default.note: Normal retirement withdrawal from age 50; members who keep working can delay withdrawal.

retirement_age_government.note: The public service retirement age could not be confirmed from an official page in this pass.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: CBSI savings deposits 0.79% less 10% withholding tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits only, after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: CBSI: 1-2 year time deposits 1.51% and 182-day T-bill 2.33%, less 10% resident withholding tax on interest
retirement_return_base.note: Base case at the after-tax 1-2 year time deposit rate (1.51% less 10%).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: CBSI: 1-2 year time deposits 1.51% and 182-day T-bill 2.33%, less 10% resident withholding tax on interest

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case near the weaker SINPF crediting years.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case somewhat below the SINPF 10-year average, since few other long-term assets are available.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case at the SINPF 10-year average.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found for Solomon Islands.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found for Solomon Islands.

gratuity_rule.note: The Employment/Labour Act text on end-of-service or long-service benefits could not be reached (PacLII returned an error), so the rule is not reported.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Solomon Islands National Provident Fund, Benefits and withdrawals and Contribution rates
public_pension_scheme.note: SINPF is a mandatory provident fund (employee 5%, employer 7.5% of wages), credited 5.5% for 2026; it pays a lump sum, with withdrawal from age 50, not a lifetime pension. youSave is the voluntary scheme for informal workers.

dps.note: No bank recurring-deposit product was identified. Informal workers can save monthly through the SINPF youSave scheme.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail government savings bond exists.

tbill_91d.note: Issued by tender through CBSI; mostly held by banks and institutions.

tbond_10y.note: Government Development Bonds are auctioned through CBSI, mainly to institutions.

equity_fund.note: There is no local stock exchange or retail equity fund; foreign investment is subject to exchange control.

gold.note: No retail gold bullion market was identified.

insuranceRegulator.name: Central Bank of Solomon Islands
insuranceRegulator.note: CBSI is the financial-sector supervisor; its site does not describe insurance supervision in detail.

insuranceComplaints.name: Central Bank of Solomon Islands (contact)
insuranceComplaints.note: No dedicated insurance ombudsman was found.
